caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man set against a plain, light beige background. The bust is painted in naturalistic colors, with the man's skin rendered in shades of light brown and beige, with brown hair. He is wearing a dark blue or black jacket with a wide lapel, decorated with metallic gold trim and buttons, and a high dark collar. There is a round medallion or pendant visible at the center of the chest, also colored gold. Beneath the bust, the base is stylized to resemble an Ionic column capital in shades of gold and brown, including a central lattice pattern and two scroll shapes on either side. The composition is centered, and the bust is shown from the chest up, facing slightly to the viewer’s left.
title: Figurehad: "Solomon Piper"
